mercury.hermeticism: Logos, mediation, writing, magic, and the art of transmission.
mercury.kabbalah: Hod; analytic mind, language, ritual form, and splendor.
mercury.alchemy: Mercury; volatile spirit, solvent, mediator between sulfur and salt.
mercury.astrology: Mercury; Gemini and Virgo; intellect, exchange, and interpretation.

venus.hermeticism: Attraction, harmony, beauty, and the binding power of sympathy.
venus.kabbalah: Netzach; desire, emotion, art, and victorious endurance.
venus.alchemy: Copper; green tincture, beauty, fertility, and cohesion.
venus.astrology: Venus; Taurus and Libra; affection, aesthetics, and value.

sun.hermeticism: Central light, consciousness, health, kingship, and the visible divine image.
sun.kabbalah: Tiferet; beauty, sacrifice, harmony, and the solar self.
sun.alchemy: Gold; perfection, incorruptibility, and the goal of the opus.
sun.astrology: Sun; vitality, visibility, purpose, and the heart.

moon.hermeticism: Reflection, imagination, flux, memory, and the vessel of forms.
moon.kabbalah: Yesod; foundation, dream, image, and astral patterning.
moon.alchemy: Silver; receptivity, whitening, purification, and lunar moisture.
moon.tarot: High Priestess and Moon; Gimel and Qoph.
moon.astrology: Moon; Cancer; tides, instinct, body rhythms, and memory.

mars.hermeticism: Force, cutting, conflict, courage, and purgation.
mars.kabbalah: Gevurah; severity, judgment, discipline, and strength.
mars.alchemy: Iron; fire, weaponry, calcination, and active separation.
mars.astrology: Mars; Aries and Scorpio; assertion, heat, and rupture.

jupiter.hermeticism: Expansion, blessing, order, rulership, and benevolent law.
jupiter.kabbalah: Chesed; mercy, generosity, and stabilized authority.
jupiter.alchemy: Tin; increase, protection, and temperate growth.
jupiter.astrology: Jupiter; Sagittarius and Pisces; abundance, doctrine, and scope.

saturn.hermeticism: Boundary, time, contemplation, mortality, and crystallization.
saturn.kabbalah: Binah; understanding, form, limitation, and the great sea.
saturn.alchemy: Lead; nigredo, gravity, age, and first matter.
saturn.astrology: Saturn; Capricorn and Aquarius; structure, consequence, and endurance.

fire.hermeticism: Volition, spirit, heat, transformation, and ascent.
fire.kabbalah: Shin; the active element and purifying spirit.
fire.alchemy: Calcination; burning away the dense and impure.
fire.tarot: Judgment; wands in the minor arcana.
fire.astrology: Aries, Leo, Sagittarius; initiative, vitality, and inspiration.

water.hermeticism: Emotion, dissolution, receptivity, and the imaginal current.
water.kabbalah: Mem; the maternal waters and reflective depth.
water.alchemy: Dissolution; returning fixed substance to fluid possibility.
water.tarot: Hanged Man; cups in the minor arcana.
water.astrology: Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces; feeling, memory, and depth.

air.hermeticism: Breath, mind, motion, mediation, and subtle exchange.
air.alchemy: Sublimation; raising substance into subtle form.
air.tarot: Fool; swords in the minor arcana.
air.astrology: Gemini, Libra, Aquarius; thought, relation, and circulation.

earth.hermeticism: Embodiment, stability, manifestation, and the field of work.
earth.kabbalah: Malkuth; kingdom and the material plane.
earth.alchemy: Salt; body, fixity, crystallization, and residue.
earth.tarot: World; disks or pentacles in the minor arcana.
earth.astrology: Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn; matter, craft, and endurance.

keter.hermeticism: Keter/Crown — the first Sefirah, the divine will, the point of unity before differentiation. Corresponds to Nous (Divine Mind) in Hermeticism.
keter.kabbalah: Keter — Crown, the first Sefirah, closest to Ein Sof. Divine will, the superconscious.
keter.alchemy: The prima materia, the unmanifest source before the work begins.
keter.tarot: The Fool — Aleph, Path 11, connecting Keter to Chokhmah.
keter.astrology: Primum Mobile — the first swirlings, beyond the fixed stars.

nous.hermeticism: Nous — Divine Mind, the first emanation from the One. The light that existed before all things. God the father in Poimandres.
nous.kabbalah: Keter — the first Sefirah, the point of contact between Ein Sof and creation.
nous.alchemy: The lapis philosophorum, the goal of the Great Work.
nous.tarot: The Fool — the spirit before descent into matter.
nous.astrology: The Primum Mobile, the first motion.

chokhmah.hermeticism: Chokhmah/Wisdom — the flash of creative insight, the father. Corresponds to the Logos (Word) in Hermeticism.
chokhmah.kabbalah: Chokhmah — Wisdom, the second Sefirah. Pure potential, the first flash of insight.
chokhmah.alchemy: Sulfur — the active, masculine principle, the fiery seed.
chokhmah.tarot: The Magician — Beth, Path 12, connecting Keter to Binah.

binah.hermeticism: Binah/Understanding — the mother, the womb of creation. Corresponds to the Demiurge (craftsman mind) in Hermeticism.
binah.kabbalah: Binah — Understanding, the third Sefirah. Form, structure, the great mother.
binah.alchemy: Salt — the body, the fixed principle, the vessel.
binah.tarot: The High Priestess — Gimel, Path 13, connecting Keter to Tiferet.

tiferet.hermeticism: Tiferet/Beauty — the center, the heart, the solar self. The goal of the soul's journey through the spheres.
tiferet.kabbalah: Tiferet — Beauty, the sixth Sefirah. Harmony, compassion, the son.
tiferet.alchemy: Gold — the philosopher's stone, the perfected self.
tiferet.tarot: The Sun — Resh, Path 30, connecting Hod to Yesod.
tiferet.astrology: The Sun — vitality, the center, the visible god.

malkuth.hermeticism: Malkuth/Kingdom — the material world, the physical realm. The place of incarnation and the starting point of the ascent.
malkuth.kabbalah: Malkuth — Kingdom, the tenth Sefirah. The Shekhinah, the divine presence in the world.
malkuth.alchemy: The prima materia, the base metal to be transmuted.
malkuth.tarot: The World — Tav, Path 32, connecting Yesod to Malkuth.
malkuth.astrology: Earth — the four elements, the physical plane.

daat.hermeticism: Da'at/Knowledge — the hidden Sefirah, the Abyss. The threshold between the Supernal Triad and the lower seven. Corresponds to the Ogdoad (eighth sphere) in Hermeticism.
daat.kabbalah: Da'at — Knowledge, the hidden Sefirah. The abyss, the veil between the divine and the manifest.
daat.alchemy: The nigredo, the black stage, the dissolution of the ego.
daat.tarot: The Hanged Man — Mem, Path 23, connecting Gevurah to Hod.
daat.astrology: The Ogdoad — the eighth sphere, beyond the seven planets.

ein sof.hermeticism: Ein Sof — the infinite, the unknowable source beyond all attributes. Corresponds to the One/Monad in Hermeticism.
ein sof.kabbalah: Ein Sof — the infinite, the boundless. The hidden God beyond all names and forms.
ein sof.alchemy: The Azoth, the universal solvent, the undifferentiated source.
ein sof.tarot: The Fool — the zero, the unmanifest before the journey begins.
ein sof.astrology: The Ain — nothingness, the void before creation.

logos.hermeticism: Logos — the Word, the son of god, the creative utterance that orders chaos. The luminous word that comes from Nous.
logos.kabbalah: Chokhmah — Wisdom, the first flash of creation. The Logos as the divine utterance.
logos.alchemy: The green lion, the active principle, the beginning of the work.
logos.tarot: The Magician — the will, the active principle, the channel.
logos.astrology: Mercury — the messenger, the mediator between realms.

demiurge.hermeticism: Demiurge — the craftsman mind, the second god. Creates the seven governors and the material cosmos. Not evil, but limited.
demiurge.kabbalah: Binah — Understanding, the mother. The structuring principle that gives form to the flash of wisdom.
demiurge.alchemy: The athanor, the furnace, the vessel of transformation.
demiurge.tarot: The Empress — the feminine creative principle, nature, fertility.
demiurge.astrology: Saturn — the limit, the boundary, the gate.

sophia.hermeticism: Sophia/Wisdom — the feminine principle of wisdom. In Gnosticism, the youngest Aeon whose fall creates the material world.
sophia.kabbalah: Chokhmah — Wisdom, the second Sefirah. Also the Shekhinah, the divine presence.
sophia.alchemy: The white queen, the lunar principle, the receptive vessel.
sophia.tarot: The High Priestess — the hidden wisdom, the veil between worlds.
sophia.astrology: The Moon — reflection, intuition, the subconscious.

pleroma.hermeticism: Pleroma/Fullness — the divine realm of perfect light and harmony. The fullness of the Aeons. Corresponds to the Ogdoad and beyond.
pleroma.kabbalah: The world of Atziluth — Emanation, the highest of the Four Worlds. The realm of the Sefirot.
pleroma.alchemy: The rubedo, the red stage, the completion of the Great Work.
pleroma.tarot: The World — the completion, the union of all opposites.
pleroma.astrology: The eighth sphere, beyond the seven planets.
